tools.name: search_adverts
tools.description: Search listings on the marketplace. Results never include seller contacts.

tools.name: get_advert
tools.description: Listing details: description, attributes, photos, seller. No contacts: use reveal_contact.

tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Seller's phone, WhatsApp or chat link. Call only when the user asks to contact the seller.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Marketplace categories, one level at a time. Use category_id in search_adverts.

tools.name: get_category_filters
tools.description: Filters available in a category (brand, model, year, storage...) for search_adverts.attributes.
